title: Implement Hero section variants (hero-centered, hero-split)
description: Implement two Hero section variants. Both accept the same HeroContent and BusinessInfo props. hero-centered shows headline/subheadline/CTA centered over a full-width background image. hero-split shows content on the left half and image on the right half.
acceptanceCriteria: Both accept `{ content: HeroContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Both render the headline, subheadline, CTA button, and background/feature image
CTA button links to the `contact` section via `href='#contact'`
Colors come from CSS custom properties (--color-primary, etc.) — not hardcoded
Components render correctly in Storybook or browser without errors
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Full viewport height section. Background image as `style={{ backgroundImage: 'url(...)' }}` with overlay using `--color-overlay` CSS var. Content centered (flexbox). Render: badge (if content.badgeText), h1 headline, p subheadline, CTA button with `--color-primary` background. Phone number from `business.phone` below the CTA.

Two-column layout (CSS grid, 50/50). Left column: badge, h1, subheadline, CTA button, phone. Right column: `` with content.imageUrl. On mobile: stack vertically (image below content). Use Tailwind `md:grid-cols-2`.
All colors reference CSS variables: CTA button `bg-[--color-primary] text-[--color-text-inverted]`, headline `text-[--color-heading]`, etc. Never hardcode hex colors in components.

Start the dev server (`npm run dev`). Navigate to the preview of a test prospect. Take a Playwright screenshot and confirm both variants render without visual errors. Verify text is readable, button is visible, image loads.

technicalNotes: All section components follow the same pattern: accept `content` and `business` props, use CSS custom properties for colors, use Tailwind for layout.
The component must be responsive — all sections should be usable on mobile and desktop.
The exported site uses the exact same component files as the admin preview — they live in `src/components/shared/` and are copied to `site-template/src/components/` at export time.
